question: After a causal price-and-volume breakout event, does three-session price acceptance above event-anchored traded average add information beyond merely delaying entry?
novelty: New event-anchored cumulative traded-average acceptance mechanism. Breakouts, volume confirmation and fixed-price pullbacks were previously studied; this is not their first study and does not identify investor ownership.

source.reuse: Reuse all six already frozen and independently verified board datasets without rebuilding, editing, adding or deleting securities or bars.
source.membership: Same period-start local-file cohorts with at least61 valid strictly prior observations. No target-period new listings. Current surviving local coverage is not historical point-in-time coverage.
source.scope: Every policy runs in every board and period, 18 fresh accounts. No selection of the previously best board, no2026 data, no holdout claim.

barValidity.calendar: Use supplied independent exchange calendar and exact slots; never compress missing/zero-volume sessions. Ignore numerical bars after registered end.
barValidity.price: Finite positive open/high/low/close/volume with low <= min(open,close) <= max(open,close) <= high; explicit nontrading historical status is invalid. Unknown historical status is retained as unknown eligibility, not fabricated.
barValidity.amount: Finite positive amount, explicitly CNY; volume explicitly shares. Per-bar amount/volume must lie within [low-0.01, high+0.01]. One-cent tolerance accommodates cent OHLC rounding, not a trading threshold.
barValidity.unknown: Missing or invalid bar, amount or unit evidence is unknown. Record reason counts, do not infer a failed price pattern, repair the bar or silently remove the security.

anchor.trigger: At A close require all exact prior20 and current bars valid; close_A > max(high of prior20) AND volume_A > max(volume of prior20). Both comparisons are strict; no RS, moving-average, investor-identity, market-breadth or calendar-date filter.
anchor.ranking: Rank every eligible anchor at A by arithmetic mean amount over prior20 descending, then symbol ascending. Select original Top5 before all later information; keep all candidates in daily evidence. No backfill, no rerank after later data or account rejection.
anchor.identity: One opportunity per selected symbol and A. Repeated anchors on subsequent dates are allowed and remain distinct, even while an account is holding. Each anchor stays fixed; later volume peaks never replace it.
anchor.scope: Only anchors inside the registered period; pre-start bars are indicator warmup and cannot create carried opportunities.

acceptance.definition: At each of A+1,A+2,A+3 closes compute cumulativeAmount=sum(amount_A..d), cumulativeShares=sum(volume_A..d), Q_d=cumulativeAmount/cumulativeShares. Acceptance means close_d*cumulativeShares >= cumulativeAmount at all three closes. Equality passes.
acceptance.timing: Each Q_d uses only data observable by that day's close. This is a close-time comparison, not a claim that the completed day's Q was known intraday.
acceptance.meaning: Q is the observed traded-average reference since A. It is not surviving-holder cost, main-force cost, net inflow, ownership or proof of support/manipulation.
acceptance.immediate: A-close decision for every original Top5 anchor; one next-exchange-open attempt under the unchanged account engine.
acceptance.delay3: A+3-close decision if all three exact post-anchor bars are valid, irrespective of acceptance. Do not recheck breakout or rerank.
acceptance.accept3: The same A+3 decision and same complete-data population as delay3, additionally requiring all three acceptance comparisons. No new candidate may replace a rejected anchor.
acceptance.unknown: If the scheduled three-session window is fully observed in-period but any required bar is missing/invalid, both delayed modes are unknown and produce no signal. Preserve each available step and all reasons, including known failures alongside unknown evidence.
acceptance.cutoff: If A+3 lies beyond the registered period, both delayed modes are right-censored and produce no signal. Retain every available step, unknown evidence and known acceptance failure so far; do not label the unfinished window an executed trade or eventual failure. Immediate opportunities remain unchanged.
acceptance.ordering: Schedules sort by signalDate, originalRank, symbol, signalId. The five signal fields remain signalId,strategyId,symbol,signalDate,originalRank.

account.exitRule: Same noProgress5 account adapter,5-percent close-trigger stop and10-percent close-trigger trailing rule. Next executable open, T+1 and board lot/limit gates unchanged. No profit cap and no holding deadline.
account.fees: Same previously bound dated historical fee policy for2022-2023, legacy policy for2024-2025 and10bp slippage per side. Real opening capacity is not certified.
account.compatibility: Retain original configs; minListingDays120/minAmount20 are not additional effective gates because FrozenSignalScorer bypasses DailyScorer. No changes to production execution or historical source-quality flags.

comparison.primary: accept3 versus delay3 isolates the registered acceptance condition within the same three-session complete-data decision clock. It is a historical policy contrast, not randomized causal proof.
comparison.secondary: delay3 versus immediate measures the combined waiting/known-data opportunity and execution-path difference. Do not attribute that whole difference to AVWAP acceptance.
comparison.readout: All18 accounts,36 years,72 halves,144 atlas stages,18 event-boundary intervals; all original opportunities and rejection/nonentry/open status. Keep fees, exposure, realized/open profit, tails, losing streaks, concentration and original quality flags visible.
comparison.eventBoundary: 2024-09-24 is descriptive only. Preserve continuous equity and positions; never restart capital or feed phase labels into entry.
comparison.success: No numerical profit or payoff hurdle, no best-board promotion, no stable-profit claim from already inspected development periods.

validation.beforeOutcomes: Meaningful synthetic causal, strict-boundary, missing/invalid unit, no-reanchor, Top5-no-backfill, cutoff and future-invariance tests; source/code/protocol pins frozen before computing real schedules.
validation.independent: Independently reconstruct all anchor candidates/ranks, traded-average numerators/denominators, decisions and schedules; freeze all18 schedules before accounts. Audit complete saved ledgers and readouts without rerunning accounts.
validation.attempts: Exclusive writes, preserve failed attempts; no alteration of frozen strategy rules after real outcomes.
